name: Kimigaita Monogatari
source:
Naoki Takeda, a student at a private all-boys high school, was approaching his second summer vacation since starting high school. He spent his school days alongside his childhood friend and classmate, Hiroyuki Kanaya. However, with only one week left until the summer break, he heard a certain rumor...

It's said that Yuichi Inoue, a first-year student and a junior on the soccer team to which Naoki was part of until spring, would be transferring to another school after this semester.

Naoki had never actually met him, but ever since hearing the rumor, the boy had begun to weigh on his mind.
